rules: Valid original Government Photo ID (Aadhaar, Voter ID, Driving License, Passport) is mandatory during check-in for all guests.
Smoking, consumption of alcohol, non-vegetarian food, and narcotics are strictly prohibited inside temple premises.
Hot water facility is available during morning hours (5:00 AM to 10:00 AM).
Pre-booking is recommended during peak festivals like Shravan Somvar, Shivratri, and Chhath Puja.
